purpose: Canonical BlueOnyx truth registry for the base-ai assistant.
default_rules: Prefer live tools for current state.
Never guess BlueOnyx-specific paths, commands, or behaviors.
Use the knowledge tool or registry before hallucinating.

entries.summary: BlueOnyx is a Linux server management platform built on the Sausalito framework and the CCE/CODB configuration stack.
entries.safe_answer_template: BlueOnyx is a Linux server management platform built on the Sausalito framework and the CCE/CODB configuration stack.

entries.summary: Sausalito is the BlueOnyx GUI, schema, handler, constructor, and configuration framework.
entries.safe_answer_template: Sausalito is the BlueOnyx GUI, schema, handler, constructor, and configuration framework.

entries.summary: CCE stores BlueOnyx configuration objects and triggers handlers when GUI changes are committed.
entries.safe_answer_template: CCE stores BlueOnyx configuration objects and triggers handlers when GUI changes are committed.

entries.summary: CODB is the object store behind CCE.
entries.safe_answer_template: CODB is the object store behind CCE.

entries.summary: CCE transactions describe object changes; failed transactions in /var/log/messages often point to the real handler or constructor problem.
entries.safe_answer_template: Failed CCE transactions in /var/log/messages often point to the real handler or constructor problem.

entries.summary: Schemas define classes, properties, validation, access rules, and handler triggers.
entries.safe_answer_template: Schemas define classes, properties, validation, access rules, and handler triggers.

entries.summary: Handlers apply validated GUI changes to the underlying system and write the live config files or service settings.
entries.safe_answer_template: Handlers apply validated GUI changes to the underlying system and write the live config files or service settings.

entries.summary: Constructors seed defaults during package install or startup.
entries.safe_answer_template: Constructors seed defaults during package install or startup.

entries.summary: A Vsite is a hosted domain object with its own quota, users, webroot, logs, and service settings.
entries.safe_answer_template: A Vsite is a hosted domain object with its own quota, users, webroot, logs, and service settings.

entries.summary: Resolve the public Vsite FQDN to its internal site group name before using quota or path data.
entries.safe_answer_template: Resolve the public Vsite FQDN to its internal site group name before using quota or path data.

entries.summary: Vsite creation is done in the BlueOnyx GUI under Site Management via the + Add button. If creation is denied, check manageSite capability and quota/limit checks such as maxVsite.
entries.safe_answer_template: Vsite creation is done in the BlueOnyx GUI under Site Management via the + Add button. If creation is denied, check manageSite capability and quota/limit checks such as maxVsite.

entries.summary: The canonical Vsite webroot lives under /home/sites/<site>/wwwroot/web/ after resolving the internal site group name.
entries.safe_answer_template: The canonical Vsite webroot lives under /home/sites/<site>/wwwroot/web/ after resolving the internal site group name.

entries.summary: A small number of bad Vsite /web owners should be corrected per site in the GUI at Site Management / <Vsite> / Services / Web Ownership by setting a real PHP preferred site admin; set_web_owner.pl is the bulk repair path when ownership drift is systemic.
entries.safe_answer_template: A small number of bad Vsite /web owners should be corrected per site in the GUI at Site Management / <Vsite> / Services / Web Ownership by setting a real PHP preferred site admin; set_web_owner.pl is the bulk repair path when ownership drift is systemic.

entries.summary: Per-Vsite logs live under /home/sites/<site>/logs/ and are useful for site-specific troubleshooting.
entries.safe_answer_template: Per-Vsite logs live under /home/sites/<site>/logs/ and are useful for site-specific troubleshooting.

entries.summary: Current user disk usage comes from live quota data, not cached CCE values.
entries.safe_answer_template: Current user disk usage comes from live quota data, not cached CCE values.

entries.summary: Current Vsite usage must be read from live quota data for the resolved site group.
entries.safe_answer_template: Current Vsite usage must be read from live quota data for the resolved site group.

entries.summary: Active Monitor is BlueOnyx's service monitoring framework for enabled services and service recovery actions.
entries.safe_answer_template: Active Monitor is BlueOnyx's service monitoring framework for enabled services and service recovery actions.

entries.summary: In BlueOnyx, Swatch refers to the monitoring side of Active Monitor, not a file display command.
entries.safe_answer_template: In BlueOnyx, Swatch refers to the monitoring side of Active Monitor, not a file display command.

entries.summary: An incident timeline correlates journalctl, service restarts, auth logs, mail logs, and web logs into one chronological evidence stream.
entries.safe_answer_template: An incident timeline correlates journalctl, service restarts, auth logs, mail logs, and web logs into one chronological evidence stream.

entries.summary: SSL health checks AdmServ and Vsite certificates for expiry, missing files, and obvious chain/signature problems.
entries.safe_answer_template: SSL health checks AdmServ and Vsite certificates for expiry, missing files, and obvious chain/signature problems.

entries.summary: PHP-FPM health checks the master PHP-FPM service plus only the extra versioned pools that Vsites actually need.
entries.safe_answer_template: PHP-FPM health checks the master PHP-FPM service plus only the extra versioned pools that Vsites actually need.

entries.safe_answer_template: Site health evidence combines web ownership, SSL state, PHP-FPM state, quota/disk usage, and centralized log evidence for a single Vsite.

entries.summary: AdmServ is the BlueOnyx administrative web server for the GUI.
entries.safe_answer_template: AdmServ is the BlueOnyx administrative web server for the GUI.

entries.summary: The AI stack is socket-activated and idle-stopped; local llama is started on demand and stopped again after inactivity.
entries.safe_answer_template: The AI stack is socket-activated and idle-stopped; local llama is started on demand and stopped again after inactivity.
